svg.title: EP2 C4 AREA 22
svg.desc: Matching colors: switches / fences Clock: timed switch Bulb: light control Green ring: healing Crossed squares: barriers / traps Box numbers: supply counts Letter / prime: warp pair After room 2’s squids, go south and skip the hall Sinow. Room 3 does not require ordinary Recoboxes. On room 4’s bridge, clear the second blocking Recobox to proceed. Do not assume every box is required. Room 6: break the barrier, then destroy Recon-spawning Recoboxes. Room 9 also requires active boxes. Near the exit, break the wall for the fixed Scape Doll pickup before advancing.
